context: Evaluates whether the consolidated report is saved with its plan, lenses and plan hash, validated, and linked from the plan, with a partial review recorded honestly.

checklist.name: Saves the dated report
checklist.description: Saves the report under .context/reviews/ with a name built from the plan file name and the date, instead of leaving it only in the chat

checklist.name: Records only the lenses that ran
checklist.description: Sets lenses_run to technical and strategic only, because the Risk reviewer was omitted, and tells the user the review is partial

checklist.name: Plan path and hash
checklist.description: Writes plan as a path relative to the report's folder and plan_hash as the SHA-256 of the plan's body (not the whole file) taken before any edit to the plan

checklist.name: Runs the validator
checklist.description: Runs scripts/validate-review-report.sh on the saved report rather than judging it by eye

checklist.name: Links the plan
checklist.description: Adds the report path to the plan's reviewed-by list, once, creating the key if needed

checklist.name: No false full review
checklist.description: Does not list a lens that did not return a review and does not overwrite an earlier report or write reviewed-by as an empty list
